name: FortiVPN
author: Christian Palladini
description: Fortinet VPN status in the Omarchy bar: connection state, assigned IP, uptime and traffic, with connect and disconnect from the panel. Drives either FortiClient or openfortivpn.

barWidget.description: Watch a Fortinet SSL VPN, connect and disconnect from the bar, and reach the SAML login in one click.

schema.label: Backend
schema.description: auto picks openfortivpn when its unit exists, otherwise FortiClient. Only openfortivpn can connect without opening a GUI.

schema.label: openfortivpn systemd unit
schema.description: For example openfortivpn@work. Leave empty to use FortiClient.

schema.label: SAML login URL
schema.description: Opened in the browser on connect, e.g. https://vpn.example.com:10443/remote/saml/start?redirect=1 — without it, connecting falls back to the FortiClient GUI.

schema.label: Browser command
schema.description: Used to open the SAML login page.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the tunnel is polled. The duration counter ticks between polls, so a slower interval still reads smoothly.

schema.label: Hide the icon while the tunnel is down
Notify when the tunnel drops on its own
schema.description: A disconnect you asked for stays silent.

schema.label: Notify when the tunnel comes up
Path to the fortivpn CLI
schema.description: FortiClient backend only. Leave empty to find fortivpn on PATH.

schema.label: Command that opens the FortiClient GUI
schema.description: FortiClient backend only, because its SAML login has to happen in the GUI's browser flow.
